hero.title: The Wizarding World of Harry Potter
hero.lede: The whole universe, and not just the story of the seven books: the founders and the houses, the creatures, magic, Quidditch, a thousand years of history and what the author added later in textbooks, on the official site, in interviews, on stage and in cinema. Tap any underlined name to open its profile.
houses.title: The houses and the founders
houses.intro: Hogwarts was founded by four wizards, and each one left a house. Tap a quarter of the crest to see the house, its colours, its animal and who founded it.
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.intro: Six periods, from the Ollivanders' workshop to what comes after the epilogue. The bands are not to scale: the first period covers two thousand years, and the fifth, seven.
explore.title: Creatures, magic, characters, places and society
explore.intro: Each profile has links to other profiles and to the moments on the timeline where it appears. The profiles reveal how the stories end. What is not in the seven books is kept separate, with the source indicated.
quidditch.title: Quidditch
quidditch.intro: Seven players per team, four balls, six hoops. Tap a position or a ball to see what it does. The solid-colour team is labelled, and the other appears only in outline.
works.title: The works
works.intro: The universe has grown in layers. They appear here from the most central to the most distant, with the dates of the original editions.
crest.aria: Hogwarts crest, divided into the four houses
crest.motto: The motto on the banner, Draco dormiens nunquam titillandus: never tickle a sleeping dragon.
crest.note: The animals look towards the H in the centre. The lion and the serpent have the lower part of their bodies behind the plaque, as the crest is usually drawn. Ravenclaw's bird appears here as the raven of the films. In the books it is an eagle.
reader.label: Profile
credits.label: Sources and credits
credits.sources.title: Sources
credits.sources.text: The basis is J.K. Rowling's seven books, the three Hogwarts textbooks, her texts on the official site, interviews, the play and the Fantastic Beasts screenplays. Dates and details were checked on the Harry Potter Wiki and on Wikipedia.
credits.names.title: Names
credits.names.text: The names follow J.K. Rowling's original British English editions: Gryffindor, Slytherin, Muggle, Quidditch. Readers of the Brazilian edition may know some of them under other names, such as Grifinória, Sonserina, trouxa and quadribol.
credits.crests.title: Crests
credits.crests.text: The illustrations of the Hogwarts crest and the four animals were supplied by the author of the guide. The house crests were assembled for the guide in their traditional format: shield, diamond-patterned field, the animal and a banner with the name (Pirata One font, SIL OFL). They are not the official designs.
credits.canon.title: What counts as canon
credits.canon.text: There is no consensus among fans about the play and the films. That is why what comes from outside the seven books is kept separate in each profile, with a source label.
